author: Matt Wolfe
description:
The amount of times I’ve said “I’ll remember that later” and absolutely did not… 😅

@MemoketAI Gem is basically designed to catch all those little follow-ups, ideas, and action items that disappear the second a meeting ends.

It can remember context across multiple conversations, pull out what you still need to do, and sync those action items into Google Calendar or Apple Reminders. You can also bring your Memoket memories into ChatGPT, Claude, Notion, and Slack.

Their pre-order offer is live now: get the Gem, the charging dock, your choice of wristband, and a full year of our Pro subscription plan for $179.  Link is in the pinned comment.

title: Your New Backup Brain Is Here
